items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: I played for him when he graduated from law school.

ctx.x: Oh my. And here’s Eddie Alley Day in San Francisco.

Oh, Willie Brown gave me that, had a day for me, the mayor. I played for him when he graduated from law school. And then the supervisors gave me a proclamation. Because like I said before, I never traveled like these other guys or nothing like that, I’m just local. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
There’s nothing wrong with that. It’s terrific. What are some of the biggest changes you’ve seen in your life, not just in music.
